name: duel_shared_clock_one_horn
description: Undertow's one clock (contract-m7 §2, the preset's clock 'shared'): one seat Ready does not call the horn; both do, and it sounds on both hollows on one tick with the early gold to each. Seat 1, well defended, clears wave 1 first: its window opens but waits, its countdown standing at the full 600 ticks, while seat 2, with no tower, still plays the wave; once seat 2's last creep is through, the window opens for both on one tick, the countdowns level, and window 2's Drift comes then. Against a caretaker rival (Duel the caretaker) the one player's Ready calls the horn, but only once the caretaker has played the window: it builds, corks and says Ready on the window's first tick, and the horn sounds on the next; two caretakers wait out the window.

steps.assert: m.hollows[0].phase == 0 and m.hollows[1].phase == 0 and m.hollows[0].countdown_t == 900 - 30 and m.hollows[1].countdown_t == 900 - 30
steps.msg: one seat Ready: the one window counts on for both

steps.assert: horns.size() == 2 and horns[0][0] == horns[1][0] and horns[0][1] == 0 and horns[1][1] == 1 and m.horn_tick == horns[0][0]
steps.msg: both Ready: one horn on both hollows
the early gold to each seat

steps.assert: m.hollows[0].phase == 0 and m.hollows[1].phase == 1 and m.hollows[0].countdown_t == 600 and m.drift_window == 0
steps.msg: seat 1 cleared and waits, its window not counting, no Drift yet
the window opened for both when seat 2 cleared: level countdowns, window 2's Drift
and now it counts down for both

steps.assert: scene.client(1).horn_tick == 1 and scene.client(1).hollows[1].phase == 1 and scene.events_where('READY', {'seat': 2})[0]['tick'] == 0 and scene.towers_of(2).size() > 0
steps.msg: against the caretaker the player's Ready calls the horn, on the tick after the caretaker built and said Ready
two caretakers wait out the window
and the horn sounds when it runs out
